events.title: v0.3.2 Announcer Update
events.summary: v0.3.2 Announcer UpdateThe race has a voice now. This update adds a full race announcer, a ground-up controller feel overhaul, a proper intro, and a load of audio and menu polish. A Race Announcer There is now a commentator calling your race in real time, so the track never feels quiet. events.title: v0.3 Supercross Update
events.summary: v0.3 Supercross Update The biggest DüRT update yet is here. Supercross joins the game, the handling got a full pass, and local split-screen is now solid. Here is everything that changed. Supercross Has Landed A stadium-style supercross track is now in the game, built by hand with rhythm sections, rollers and big jumps. Its own feel. events.title: DüRT Demo V0.2.2: Smoother Handling, Wall Riding, and Full Controller Support
events.summary: DüRT Demo V0.2.2 A handling and compatibility patch. The bike turns better, slides along walls cleanly, the AI stops driving the wrong way, and it now works with basically any controller you plug in. 🏁 Reworked Steering Speed-sensitive steering: sharp and responsive when you are slow, calmer and more stable at high speed, so the bike is easy to place in corners and not twitchy flat out. 🧱 Smoother Wall Riding The bike now slides cleanly ALONG walls instead of sticking and scrubbing into them. events.title: DüRT Demo V0.2.1: Difficulty, Controls Layout, and Controller Polish
events.summary: DüRT Demo V0.2.1 A quick follow-up to V0.2, focused on difficulty options and making the menus feel great on a controller and Steam Deck. 🎚️ Difficulty Options A new difficulty setting in the Gameplay options, with a twist that keeps every race interesting. Choose Easy, Medium, or Hard. Even on lower settings a couple of rivals ride one tier above to keep you honest. events.title: DüRT Demo V0.2 is Live: Local Split-Screen, Full Controller Support, and Better
events.summary: DüRT Demo V0.2 is here This is the biggest demo update yet. Local split-screen, full controller and Steam Deck support, reworked bike handling, and smarter AI.
